name: 3D Box: Box 0 moves north · 1t at (0, 4, 1)
description:
One Up command in a 6×6 room; expect exactly 1 tick after Start.
Box 0: 5 cells, starting at (0, 3, 1) through (3, 3, 2); Player: 1 cell, starting at (0, 4, 1); Box 1: 26 cells, starting at (3, 2, 1) through (5, 4, 3). Terrain and fixtures: Limestone.

Tick 1: Box 0 moves 1 north; Player moves 1 north; Box 1 moves 1 north.

Coordinates are (x, y, z); north decreases y. Every frame is checked in all four rotations. Unmentioned objects retain their authored positions and states.
